lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid pattern. Centroids exhibit higher spatial density and smaller radii in the anterior region immediately posterior to the gills, transitioning to lower density and larger radii towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs to form a visible grid. These nodes are most prominent where the spots align with vertical cutaneous folds in the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible across the upper third of the visible flank, displaying a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity luminance on the dorsal aspect to deep shadow in the ventral trough.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, irregular high-luminance lesion or mark is visible on the anterior leading edge of the pectoral fin, characterized by a jagged morphology and a loss of standard pigmentation pattern.
